serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I don’t know yet if she will ever come here. I still need to ask her about it.
#Annalie.Face.shocked
Lady Annalie: W-what?! What have you been doing all this time up until now?! Talk to her about it and come! 
#Annalie.Face.normal
You: Agh! Alright, alright, I will talk with her, but I can’t promise anything! Just give me a while to work things out and don’t bother me too much with it.
Lady Annalie: Yay! I can’t wait!
